name: What is the difference between a custom remodel and a renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom remodel and a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: While often used interchangeably, a custom remodel typically implies a deeper level of personalization and often structural changes to redesign a space according to specific client needs and unique aesthetics. A renovation usually focuses on restoring or updating an existing space to its original condition or a more modern standard without necessarily altering its fundamental layout or purpose. Both aim to improve a home, but custom remodeling offers tailored solutions beyond standard updates.
acceptedAnswer.description: A custom remodel deeply personalizes a space, often with structural changes, while a renovation updates or restores existing areas without major layout alterations.
